game.q: the holy man asks why he rides with swords. how does the Guru answer?

wrong.show: no. those swords had a real job: protecting the poor.
wrong.quit: not at all. the inner life stayed whole.

game.right: YES. inside, a hermit. outside, a prince. many tellings say the holy man was satisfied.

end.line: as the tradition tells it, a young guru carried two swords, for the world and the spirit, and held them together.
end.l2: one for the spirit. both held.

cliff.s2: next: the kitchen, and the people you never notice.

share: one guru. two swords. zero contradiction. a traditional sikh story on infinite hill
